candidate_train: existing legal v1 train plus preregistered new train records
candidate_dev: existing legal v1 dev plus preregistered new dev records

full_model.selection_rule: lowest full candidate development loss; ties choose earlier optimizer step
full_model.decoding: complete candidate dev, greedy, batch 1, no JSON extraction or repair

baseline_rule: one fixed configuration per baseline; no sweep; logistic deterministic and neural baselines use the three full-model seeds

aggregation.small_sample_interpretation: differences are inconclusive unless consistently large; no scientific claim

prior_pilot: old seed-2026080101 v1 pilot is historical engineering context only and may not be pooled with candidate seeds
forbidden: frozen IID/OOD/protected prediction or image-content access
modification of frozen control backbone, forward model, H1-CEM, labels, or v1 sealed artifacts
